id.description: Unique ID of the paystub object.

account.description: ID of the account associated with the paystub.

payroll_document.description: ID of the [payroll document object](/api-reference/payroll-documents#object) associated with this paystub.

deduction_list.description: An itemized list of deductions listed on the paystub. Each object corresponds to one line item.

filing_status.description: Information on the user's filing status.

tax_list.description: An itemized list of tax withholdings listed on the paystub. Each object corresponds to one line item.

status.description:
Payment status of the paystub.
- `completed` - Payment has been made to the user.
- `scheduled` - Payment is scheduled to be made to the user.
- `cancelled` - Payment was cancelled, and was not nor will be paid to the user.
- `excluded` - Tag used for dummy/sample/watermarked/test paystubs present in the account. May also include non-employee payment records. These paystubs are excluded when generating reports and other calculations.

paystub_date.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) of the payment date, sourced from the paystub.

start_date.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) of the start of the work period.

end_date.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) of the end of the work period.

paystub_period.description: Start date and end date of the work period.

gross_pay.description: Total gross pay from the paystub period before taxes or deductions. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

deductions.description: Total amount of deductions from the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

taxes.description: Total tax amount from the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

net_pay.description: Net pay (gross pay minus taxes and deductions) from the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

reimbursements.description: Total reimbursement amount from the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

hours.description: Total hours worked during the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

fees.description: Total fees incurred during the paystub period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

net_pay_ytd.description: Net pay year-to-date, including this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

gross_pay_ytd.description: Gross pay year-to-date, including this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

employment.description: [Employment](/api-reference/employments) ID. Can be used as a filter when [listing paystubs](/api-reference/paystubs/list-all-paystubs).

city.description: Name of the city, town, district, or similar regional entity.

line1.description: Address-Line 1, usually street address or P.O. Box information.

line2.description: Address-Line 2, usually the apartment or unit number.

state.description: State, county, province, region, or equivalent.

employer_address.description: Object containing employer address information, sourced from the paystub.

created_at.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) when the paystub object was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) when a property value of the paystub object most recently changed.

destinations.description: Contains information on where and how pay was delivered to the user.

hours_ytd.description: Total hours worked year-to-date, including this paystub's work period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

deductions_ytd.description: Total deductions year-to-date, including amounts from this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

taxes_ytd.description: Total taxes year-to-date, including amounts from this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

gross_pay_list.description: An itemized list of gross pay listed on the paystub. Each object corresponds to one line item.

gross_pay_list_totals.description:
Sums the values of `gross_pay_list` objects based on their `type`:
* **base** = base + pto
* **overtime** = overtime
* **commission** = commission
* **bonus** = bonus
* **other** = disability + benefits + tips + stock + other

amount.description: Amount of the deduction. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

name.description: Name or description of the deduction.

amount_ytd.description: Total amount deducted year-to-date, including the amounts from this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

reference.description: Describes where the payment was sent, such as a checking account or bank name.

amount.description: Pay amount sent to the destination. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

method.description: Payment method, such as direct deposit.

routing_number.description: Routing number of the bank account.

account_number.description: Account number of the bank account.

name.description: Name of the card where the payout was sent.

location.description:
Local jurisdiction. Values depend on `type`.
- if type is `federal` - `null`
- if type is `state` - state abbreviation code
- if type is `local` - city name or area code

name.description: Name or description of the gross pay line item.

type.description:
Categorized type of gross pay, based on `name`. Used in `gross_pay_list_totals`.
- `base`
- `pto`
- `overtime`
- `commission`
- `bonus`
- `disability`
- `benefits`
- `tips`
- `stock`
- `other`

start_date.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) of the start of the work period.

end_date.description: Timestamp ([ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) of the end of the work period.

rate.description: Hourly rate of gross pay earnings for this line item. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

hours.description: Hours worked for this line item. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

amount.description: Gross pay earned from this line item. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

hours_ytd.description: Total hours worked year-to-date related to this gross pay line item, including this paystub's work period. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

amount_ytd.description: Total gross pay earned year-to-date related to this gross pay line item, including this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

amount.description: Gross pay earned from line items of this type. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

amount_ytd.description: Total gross pay earned year-to-date from line items of this type, including this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

hours.description: Hours worked from line items of this type. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

hours_ytd.description: Hours worked year-to-date from line items of this type, including this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

rate_implied.description: Calculated ratio of `amount` to `hours` of gross pay list totals. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

rate_implied_ytd.description: Calculated ratio of `amount_ytd` to `hours_ytd` of gross pay list totals. Returned as a decimal string with exactly four decimal places.

amount.description: Amount of the tax withholding. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.

name.description: Name or description of the tax withholding.

amount_ytd.description: Total tax withholdings year-to-date (specific to the tax `type`), including the amounts from this paystub. Returned as a decimal string with exactly two decimal places.
